capabilities: Add comments to selected text or whole notes
Highlight commented text in the editor
Navigate between comments and their anchored text
Search, sort, and manage comments in a side pane
disambiguation: Despite the name, it does not create separate side notes; it anchors comments to text ranges inside existing notes.
extras: Comments are stored in data.json by default, with optional per-note Markdown files in a configurable folder; selections under 10 characters or identical text within the ±50-line recovery window can anchor to the wrong instance after external edits.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to comment on part of a sentence without inserting markup into the note text.
summary: Annotation plugin that anchors comments to selected text and lists them in a side pane with editor highlights.
